name: LyondellBasell
description: LyondellBasell is mainly a maker of commodity plastics: it cracks ethane, propane and naphtha into ethylene and propylene and turns them into polyethylene and polypropylene, plus intermediates such as propylene oxide, styrene and acetyls, and plastic compounds for cars. It earns the spread between resin prices and feedstock cost, which has collapsed, so 2025 was an operating loss of $420M after $1,251M of impairments. It is cutting its weakest assets: it shut its Houston refinery in February 2025, agreed to sell four European olefins and polyolefins sites (about 25% of that segment's capacity; a $734M loss booked in Q2 2026), and cut its quarterly dividend from $1.37 to $0.69 in February 2026. It also licenses polyolefin process technology, a small high-margin line.
